title: LATEST SHIPPING
description:
At Indomaja, we understand that reliable shipping is as important as quality production. Our logistics team manages every step of the delivery process from order preparation to container loading with precision, efficiency, and full transparency. We work closely with trusted local and international freight partners to ensure that each shipment reaches its destination on time and in perfect condition.

All of our products are packaged according to international export standards, ensuring safety and durability during transit. For fragile items and wooden crafts, we use custom wooden crates and reinforced packaging systems designed to withstand long-distance sea or air transport. Every crate is fumigated, labeled, and certified, complying with international shipping regulations and sustainability requirements. This attention to detail ensures that each product arrives safely and ready for display.

Beyond logistics, we view shipping as part of our commitment to long-term trust and partnership. Our clients can rely on consistent communication, transparent documentation, and flexible arrangements tailored to their needs. Through careful coordination and continuous improvement, Indomaja guarantees a smooth, secure, and dependable delivery experience for every order.

title: PRODUCTION PROCESS
description:
At Indomaja, every creation begins with a careful selection of authentic Indonesian natural materials. We source our clay, stone, and wood directly from local regions known for their quality and character. Each material is then inspected and sorted by our skilled artisans to ensure that only the finest resources are used. This process reflects our commitment to sustainability and authenticity, the very foundation of our craftsmanship.

Once the materials are prepared, our artisans begin shaping them through a combination of traditional techniques and modern precision. Every curve, texture, and finish is crafted by hand, embodying the spirit of Indonesian artistry passed down through generations. Throughout the production process, we maintain strict quality control standards to ensure consistency, durability, and excellence in every piece we produce.

After shaping and finishing, each product undergoes a meticulous inspection and refinement process before packaging and export. Our production facilities in Yogyakarta and Tulungagung operate efficiently by utilizing local resources, ensuring optimal transport and production timelines. Beyond production, our focus remains on building long-term trust delivering not only high-quality products but also reliability and partnership that reflect Indomaja’s enduring values.

title: OUR WAREHOUSE
description:
Indomaja’s warehouse plays a vital role in maintaining the quality and readiness of every product we create. Strategically located near our production facilities, our warehouse is designed to store materials and finished goods in an organized and controlled environment, ensuring efficiency across every stage of our operations.

Each item is carefully arranged and monitored to preserve its condition, especially for natural materials such as stone and terracotta that require proper handling. Our team ensures that every product remains protected, clean, and ready for shipment at any time.

Beyond storage, the warehouse also supports our ability to manage inventory and fulfill orders with consistency and speed. By maintaining a well-structured system, we are able to respond to client demands efficiently while upholding the quality standards that define Indomaja. This operational strength allows us to build lasting partnerships based on reliability, transparency, and trust.
